page.layout: Top: running head centred and page number at top left; two circular medallion portraits with inscriptions side by side, left and right; below them one column of text with two paragraphs, a verse quotation and a closing paragraph; no margin notes.

main_text.l: AESO
PVS PHRYGIVS
RHODO
PE. MER.
ÆSOPVS Phrygius, facie quidem & corpore deformis
fuit: at verò iocis & fabulis omnium facetissimus. Conditione
etiam fuit seruus, tempore Croesi Lydorū Regis (de quo pagina
sequēte) autor fuit quidem fabularum, quem citare non dedi-
gnatur Aristoteles 2.li.Rhetoricorum: & Plato in 1. Phædri : &
Apuleius de deor. fom. fabulas ac vitam eius non est hic locus
recensendi, & vulgatiora sunt quàm ut recitatione aut cōmenda-
tione egeant. legat qui volet Volaterranum li.13. & 38. praeterea
Æsopi vitam à Maximo Planude descriptam Græcè, atque e-
tiam latinam factā, quæ præponitur eiusdem fabulis. Hic furti
falsò Delphis accusatus, de rupe insons præcipitatur.
RHODOPE, siue Rhodopis meretrix fuit famosissima,
ex Thracia, Æsopi aliquandiu conserua, postea à Charaxo, siue
Coraxe, Sapphus Poëtriæ fratre, qui eius amore tenebatur, in-
gēti pecunia redempta: cuius sic meminit Sappho apud Ouid.
21. & ultima epistola:

l.i: Arsit inops frater, victus meretricis amore,
Mixtáque cum turpi damna pudore tulit.
Factus inops, agili peragit freta cærula remo:
Quásque male amisit, nunc male quærit opes.
Me quoque, quòd monui bene multa fideliter, odit:
Hoc mihi libertas, hoc pia lingua dedit.

main_text.l: Scribit Plinius lib.36.cap.12. Rhodopen tantas opes meretricio
quæstu cumulasse, vt insignem turrim, siue pyramidem, suis
sumptibus extruxerit.

page.notes: The two medallions carry circular inscriptions that wrap around the rim: left "AESO" and "PVS PHRYGIVS" (reading AESOPVS PHRYGIVS), right "RHODO" and "PE. MER." (reading RHODOPE MER.); the wrap-around letters are partly worn, so the middle of the left inscription is reconstructed from its two visible parts. Doubtful: "Quásque" in the verse may be "Quæsque" or "Quásque" (the tilde reading is uncertain); "quàm" and "ut" are printed as "vt" in the second paragraph. Printing errors left as printed: "fom." for "som." in "de deor. fom.", and "Sapphus" for "Sapphus" as printed. Stains at the bottom of the page and the faint marks at the lower left are not printed text and are omitted.
